tickets.title: OAuth2 Token Refresh Loop on Multi-tenant Dashboard
tickets.description: Users authenticating via enterprise SSO encounter an infinite 302 redirect loop when JWT access token expires. The refresh token rotation payload returns HTTP 400 Bad Request due to mismatched audience claim in token introspection endpoint.

diagnosticData.errorMessage: HTTP 400 Bad Request - Invalid Audience Claim: aud mismatch
diagnosticData.stepsToReproduce:
1. Log into portal via Okta SAML/SSO.
2. Wait for 15-minute token TTL expiry.
3. Trigger silent refresh background call.
4. Observe infinite 302 redirect back to auth handler.
diagnosticData.expectedBehavior: Token introspection returns a renewed short-lived JWT without disrupting session state.
diagnosticData.actualBehavior: Backend rejects request with 400 Bad Request, triggering client app route reload loop.

internalNotes.body: Replicated issue in staging environment. The Auth-Proxy pod v4.20.1 strips the 'aud' parameter during payload transformation.

timeline.author: Samira Noor
timeline.note: Client CFO Marcus Reed flagged urgent login loop affecting trading floor controllers in Hong Kong branch.

timeline.author: Arthur Pendelton
timeline.note: Assigned to Evelyn Shaw (Senior Support). High SLA penalty threshold reached.
timeline.escalationReason: P1 high impact customer facing authentication failure.

timeline.author: Evelyn Shaw
timeline.note: Introspection payload in Auth-Proxy strips issuer audience param on silent refresh. Handoff to Development Team.
timeline.escalationReason: Code fix required in Auth-Proxy microservice repository.

timeline.author: Priya Sharma
timeline.note: Hotfix branch fix/auth-token-refresh pushed. Staging deploy running now for QA signoff.
